page.intro: Author the blocks visitors land on. Hero is the prose paragraph + chat input. Insights and projects are windows onto your corpus — pin published entries and the page shows each one's title + excerpt, linking into the reader. Below that: where you are, and how to reach you. Changes persist via PUT /admin/page.

pinManager.empty: no pins yet — this section is hidden on the page.
pinManager.noneToPin: nothing to pin — publish a corpus entry first.

domain.effectiveHostNote: · used by code share links, QRs, gate footer.

byoai.modeHelp: When on, the gate page shows a "bring your own AI" option below the code entry.

preview.byoaiWelcome: Hi. You're running on your own API key — pay for inference, public slice only. Private topics return a “need a code” response.
preview.selectCode: select a code from the left

intro.after: . Write one below, or drive the same lifecycle from Claude over MCP — both do the same thing. A page can read your corpus and carry your AI; an access code can be pointed at one, so presenting that code opens the page instead of the default chat.

empty.lead: No custom pages yet. Owner creates / builds / promotes via MCP

customPages.authorHelp: Paste the page's App.tsx. It is built in a sandbox and, if the build succeeds, published at /p/<slug>. You can import @standmeet/sdk to read your corpus and to ask your AI.
customPages.previewEmpty: अभी कोई बिल्ड नहीं — प्रीव्यू के लिए बनाएँ
customPages.boundNone: no code opens this — anonymous only
customPages.byoaiOn: readers may bring their own key
customPages.byoaiNote: Applies only when nobody presents a code. A reader arriving with a code is scoped by that code, and this setting does not apply.
customPages.previewNoBuild: Nothing built yet. Ask your AI to write and build this page.
